hypothesis: hypothesis.md: persistence of relative pullback suitability across currencies; explicitly posthoc follow-up to first training
baseline: all-symbol frozen pullback05, training only comparison
entry_timeframe: daily Sunday merged Monday; same source as base
entry_rules: base pullback05 shadow entries accepted by past-only monthly selection and capacity

exit_rules.boundary: actual last close, shadow boundary excluded from ranking

final_period_prior_exposure: All periods previously viewed elsewhere; follow-up design informed by prior training, not untouched OOS

monthly_selection.cutoff: minimum raw first timestamp in trading month across all symbols; exit exposure strictly earlier
monthly_selection.lookback_lower: trading month first minus candidate months inclusive

capacity.order: exit exposure first then raw entry ascending, tie symbol alphabetical

cost_and_fill_model: base protocol unchanged; primary fixed1.8 or metadata+.4 plus carry.2, diagnostic carry0/1
position_sizing_and_currency: equal initial R additive score, no monetary account return; constituent gross position limits

acceptance_gates.profitable_symbols: strictly more than half active symbols
acceptance_gates.selection: one: worst PF descending, worst mean R descending, worst MTM DD ascending, id
acceptance_gates.failure_stop: no fallback; these 3 are final additional budget

cross_symbol_rule: past-only dynamic monthly top5, active>=5 and profits strict majority; no fixed hindsight pair list
code_identifier: scripts/research_daily_adaptive_pullback.py plus frozen base code/protocol/hypothesis and input hashes
frozen_at: exact UTC in run hashes before results
